book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: JA' AN SCARTA NAJ PABLO TET EB CREYENTE BEY ROMA

content: Kun Wej Jaxca Chi Yoche Eb Ket Creyenteal

Jaonti', tec'an jon xa yin yet Dios, yutol chi xa na'cha el ku tol c'am sowalil wan tu'. Pero ey eb man to tec'an oj yei. Chi xiw eb yu. Yuxan cu cuenta kak'on techa eb c'am to stec'anil tu', yet watx' manchej somcha el eb ku. C'am chi ske' comon c'al chi kute tzet chi yoche cu na'bal.
Jun jun jon, chi ojab kun wej tzet chi ẍa' sc'ul ket creyenteal, yet watx', watx' yet eb. Catu' chi oc eb yin stec'anil.

Ja' naj Cristo, c'am chi yun asan tzet chi yoche. Ja' tzet chi yoche Dios jix yune'. Pero chi yal yul An Juun jaxca ti': “Ja' yet chi buchwa eb ja win, jain chi wab pax sya'il,” ẍi Jesús yul An Juun tu'.
Masanil tzet tz'ibebil can yul An Juun yet peyxa tu', ey yopiso cu scuyoni. Chi yak' cu tec'anil, chi yak'on pax smimanil cu c'ul yet watx' chi ka c'al oc Dios yip oj cu c'ul.
Ja' Dios chi ak'on cu tec'anil, catu' chi yak'on pax smimanil cu c'ul. Chin k'an tet Dios chi colwa kin yu chi cu ec' yin watx' c'ulal cu masanil jaxca jix yun yec' Cristo.
Ta jaxca tu' junxane na'bale oj je yune'. Jun laan xa c'al je yalon je watx' k'ane tet Dios, smam naj Kaawil Jesucristo.
Jun Sk'aneal Yet Colbanile Albil Can El Snan Xol Eb Man Israel Oj
Yuxan, sowalil chi cu cha' masanil eb ket creyenteal cu nan cu xol, yutol jaxca tu' jix cu yute ẍa'on Cristo yu koc yetoj, yu xeclo el oj tol miman swatx'il sc'ul Dios.

Chi wal wan ti' e ex an, yutol ja' Cristo tu' jix jul yak' sba yak'omal servil eb yet Israelal. Ja' jix jul ak'on can yun tzet yalnaj can Dios tet eb kichmam, yet jix yak'on can sti' tet eb. Yuxan jaxca ti' jix yute x'oxon el Cristo tol chi c'al yun tzet chi yal Dios.
Yetoj pax oj, yu pax eb man Israel oj, yuxan jix jul ec' Cristo, yet watx' chi yal eb watx' k'ane tet Dios, yutol jix ok' sc'ul yin eb. Tol chi yal yul An Juun jaxca ti':

content.text: Ja' xol eb man Israel oj, oj wal watx' k'ane e ach.
Oj jin bit'ne pax wan bit' e ach.

content: Chi yalon pax jun xa ti' yul An Juun:

content.text: Jaex man jex Israel oj, tzala nej yetoj eb sconob Dios.

content: Ey bey chi yal pax jaxca ti':

content.text: Jantaj jex ma jex Israel oj, al wej je watx' k'ane tet naj Kaawil.
Je masanil, jaex chex ec' bey jun jun conob, al wej el oj, tol miman yel oc apnoj naj Kaawil.

content: Tz'ibebil pax can yu naj Isaías yul An Juun tu' jaxca ti':

content.text: Ey jun yic'aal naj Isaí oj aloj. Ja' oj ale oc Yaawil oj eb man Israel oj.
Ja' jun tu', oj yaoc eb yip oj sc'ul, ẍi yul An Juun.

content: Ja' Dios bey chi tit yip cu c'ul chi woche chi ak'on pax je tzala c'ulal, yetoj watx' c'ulal snan je xol, yutol che yaoc Dios yin je c'ul. Ta jaxca tu' oj yak' c'al yip je na'bal, yutol ja' Yespíritu Dios chi ak'on yipalil e ex.
Jex wuẍtaj, jex wanab, wotaj sic'lebil an, tol watx' je na'bal, catu' caw jelan jex yin yet Dios. Wotaj an, tol caw chi ske' je yak'len je na'bal je xol titu'.

Cax c'al quey tu' je beybal, pero c'am chin xiw jin tz'ibentoj wan cuybanile tu' e ex an, yu jin jejon je na', yet watx' c'am chi to q'uey c'ulal je yu. Chi wun jaxca ti' an, yutol ja' Dios jix ak'on jun wopiso ti' an yu swatx' c'ulal.

Ja' jix ak'on wopiso wak'on servil Jesucristo snan xol eb man Israel oj an. Ja' wopiso ak'bil yu an, ja' ton alo el sk'aneal yet colbanile jix yak' Dios, yet watx' ey ojab eb man Israel oj, oj waoc yul sk'ab an. Jaxca junoj sa'beal chi wak' tet Dios. Jun chi ẍa' sc'ul Dios. Jaxca tu' eb yul sat, yutol ja' naj Espíritu chi i'on oc eb yetoj.
Yutol chi mulna Cristo wetoj an, yuxan chi ske' walon an, tol miman yel oc apnoj jun mulnail chi wun tet Dios ti' an.

C'am chi ske' walon tzet jix el yunen wan xa eb chi ak'wi servil Dios pax oj. Pero c'am chin xiw walon tzet chi el yunen Cristo yin jin sk'anbalnen yet jix ak'le sjije eb man Israel oj. Jix jin ec' walon can sk'aneal tet eb an. Ey pax wan tzet yetal jix jin tx'ox el xol eb an.

Ey wan milagro, wan tzet yetal chi q'uey a sc'ul eb yu, tx'oxbil wu snan xol eb an, c'al wan xa tzet chi tx'oxon el yipal Dios. Yutol jix yak' naj Santo Espíritu yipalil e in an. Jaxca c'al tu' jix jin ec' wute walon el swatx' k'ane Cristo bey jun jun conob. Ja' bey Jerusalén, ja' titu' jix babi wal el an. Jix jin ec' wal el bey jun jun conob, masanta' c'al jix jin apni bey yul jun lugar chi yij sbi Ilírico.
Jaxca c'al ti' jix wute wak'on wip walon el sk'aneal yet colbanile bey jun jun lugar bey c'am to chi able sk'aneal Cristo. C'am chi woche tol ja' bey albil xa el yu wanoj xa chin ec' wal el an.
Jaxca yalon can yul An Juun bey chi yal jaxca ti':

content.text: Ja' bey c'am to chi apni sk'aneal, oj apnoj oc oj.
Yetoj eb c'am to c'al chi aben sk'aneal, oj na'cha el yu eb, ẍi yul An Juun.

content: Chi Yoche Naj Pablo Chi To Bey Roma
Ec'al el chi woche chex to wil an. Pero yu wopiso ti', c'am chi ske' jex to wiloni. Jal tinani' xin, jix lawi jin mulnail bey wan lugarlaj ti'.

Yuxan chin na', ja' yet oj jin toj bey Espaá, catu' oj jex ec' wilon an, yu ec' wak'on tzalaboj jin c'ul je yetoj an. Oj xew wec' jayeb oj c'u je yetoj xin, catu' chi woche chex colwa wetoj yet chin to bey Espaá tu'.
Pero tinani', ja' bey Jerusalén oj jin baboj ec' oj, yu ec' wak'on jun colwal tet eb etbil xa yu Dios titu'.
Yutol jix el yin sc'ul eb a Macedonia yetoj eb a Acaya yi'on a jun colwal, catu' chi to tet eb creyente meba' bey Jerusalén tu'.

Jix el yin sc'ul eb yaontoj jun colwal tu'. Watx' ton jaxca tu', yutol jaxca tol ey sjec' eb tet eb a Jerusalén tu'. Ja' eb a Jerusalén tu', Israel eb. Ja' eb jix colwa yin eb man Israel oj tu' yet jix yalon sk'aneal yet colbanile tet eb. Yuxan, ja' eb man Israel oj tu', scuenta ton eb scolwa yin eb Israel tu' yetoj nioj tzet yetal ey tet eb yetoj scolwal tu'.
Yuxan sowalil chin ec' wak' jun colwal tu' tet eb a Jerusalén tu' an. Chi lawi tu' xin, catu' chex ec' wilon yet lalan jin to bey Espaá tu' an.
Wotaj an, tol ja' yet oj jin apnoj e ex tu' an, miman swatx' c'ulal Cristo oj yak' e on.

Jex wuẍtaj, jex wanab, ja' naj Yespíritu Dios chi ak'oni, tol chi cu cam c'ulne cu ba. Yu jun cam c'ulal tu' chin k'an e ex, caw che yak' je yip je yoc yin txa wetoj an. Caw chex txali tet Dios wu an, yutol jaxca ti' chi yoche sc'ul Kaawil Jesucristo.
Che k'an tet Dios tol oj jin scol el yul sk'ab eb man creyente oj a Judea. Chex txali pax yu jun colwal oj wi'toj tet eb creyente a Jerusalén tu' an, yet watx' chi tzala eb yet chi ẍa'on eb.
Chex txali pax wu an, yet watx' yin tzala c'ulal chi yun wapni oc e ex tu' an, ta jaxca tu' chi el yin sc'ul Dios. Catu' chin ec' xew jayeb oj c'u je yetoj titu' an.
Ja' Dios ak'om watx' c'ulal cu xol, chi woche chi oc Dios je yetoj je masanil bey titu'. Amén.
